document.title: Hello, stranger!
document.text:
# Hello, stranger!

Nice to have you here. We know you just want to write, but please bear with us for a brief moment.

Passage is designed as a focused writing and close-reading environment. It combines the distraction-free purity of a minimalist editor with powerful structural markup, inline annotations, and an AI agent harness.

### Getting Started

- **Writing**: Just start typing. Everything is saved automatically into your library.
- **Markup**: Use `#` for headings, `>` for blockquotes, and `-` for bullet lists.
- **Annotations**: Select any phrase and press `⌘L` or type {anchor|your comment} to add an inline annotation.
- **Suggestions & Agent**: Click the ✦ button in the toolbar to inspect spelling, grammar, and dispatch instructions to your Antigravity agent.

Before typing your first sentence, word, character, or idea, take a moment to explore the workspace. You can toggle the library sidebar with ⌘1, inspect sheet snippets with ⌘2, focus exclusively on the editor with ⌘3, or monitor word counts, outlines, and suggestions with ⌘4.

Whether you are drafting an academic treatise, reviewing an official administrative report, or collaborating with autonomous agents, Passage keeps your mind centered on what matters most: your prose. Enjoy writing with clarity and focus.
